children: George Ted Rogers III disclosed an 8.5% stake in Vulcan Infrastructure and Power Inc.'s Class A common stock. He filed the Schedule 13D on September 17, 2026, after buying shares in a July 2026 subscription that closed on September 10 and receiving recent equity grants. The move highlights his deepening role at the company, including a new seat on the Compensation Committee.

Rogers holds most of his shares for investment and will continue to help oversee the company as a director. He joined the Compensation Committee on September 10, 2026, and he may talk with management and other directors about strategy and governance. He stated he has "no present plan or proposal" for major corporate actions beyond his board duties.
He may buy more or sell some of his shares in the future to match his investment goals. He also remains eligible for future equity awards under the company’s incentive plan.

George Ted Rogers III is a U.S. private investor and a director of Vulcan Infrastructure and Power Inc. He invests his own capital and has served on Vulcan’s board since 2021, most recently joining its Compensation Committee. His approach centers on direct ownership and active board engagement to support company strategy.
